rationale: The failure occurred because we landed on the homepage (no product tiles) rather than a PLP, and likely encountered an EU cookie banner. We prioritize a non-invasive override: start directly on a stable PLP (men/new-in), enforce the en-de locale, and add cookie-accept handling. We also append broad but specific PLP/PDP selectors commonly used on Moncler/SFCC to improve robustness without replacing existing ones. URL normalization prevents locale traps and monclergroup.com misnavigation.
code_hints: After initial navigation, race accept of the OneTrust cookie banner (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler) against PLP container detection; click consent if present, then proceed.
If no product tiles are found within 3–4s on any page that is not clearly a PLP, attempt a direct goto to the fallback PLP https://www.moncler.com/en-de/men/new-in.
On PLP, ensure tiles are visible by waiting for [data-pid] within .product-grid; if lazy-loaded, scroll a couple of viewports and re-query.
When extracting PDP URL from a tile, prefer anchors within the tile root (a.c-product-tile__link or a.product-tile__link) and ensure href stays under /en-de/.
On PDP, prefer [itemprop='price'] getAttribute('content') when present; fallback to visible .product-price/.price .sales .value text.
